concerns.text: FR-006 (GLMM) and Scale Assumption (10x50) are referenced in T000a/T000b, but the tasks are marked [X] (complete) despite the Analyze report confirming the spec amendment text block is missing and the spec file is not updated. Without the actual amendment text in T000a and the applied change in T000b, downstream tasks (T004c, T028) lack the authorized basis to implement GLMM, leaving FR-006 and the Scale Assumption unimplemented.

T007 mandates generating a 'global pool of unique task scenarios' with 'exact proportional distribution' but fails to specify the total count (500 tasks) required to satisfy the Spec's Scale Assumption (10 profiles × 50 tasks). The task description is ambiguous on the quantity, risking a mismatch between the generated pool and the 1,500-run matrix requirement.

FR-005 requires 'multi-hop reasoning checks via logic verification (Z3)'. T021b describes the Z3 logic but lacks the explicit 'text-to-SMT transformation logic' definition required to make the task verifiable and deterministic. Without this specific transformation logic defined in the task, the implementation of FR-005 is incomplete and non-deterministic.

FR-001 (CPU-only inference with OOM protection) and Constitution Principle VII (Resource-Constrained) require robust error handling. T045 (Error Propagation) and T044 (Data Flow Fix) are deferred to Phase 9 (Revision) rather than being part of the core implementation (Phase 2/3). This deferral leaves the initial implementation of FR-001 and the data pipeline vulnerable to race conditions and silent Z3 failures, violating the requirement for a robust, deterministic pipeline.

T000a and T000b are marked [X] (complete) in the tasks file, but the Analyze report and the task descriptions themselves indicate the actual amendment text and spec update are missing. This creates a false state of completion for critical gating tasks.
